warnings: 'New' is the channel's spelling of Nu Holdings (curated channel alias); 'Sandix' (Sandisk), 'Entropic'/'Entropics' (Anthropic), 'SCAS' (strategic customer agreements), 'DM'/'DRM' (DRAM) and 'FAPS' (fabs) are kept as spoken.
The Broadcom AI-revenue sentence uses 'It'; the subject is written as Broadcom (named in the same passage) because a generic reference would inherit the title's asset (Micron).
The free-cash-flow peak/decline figures ($168.7 billion, then $145 billion) look like on-screen estimates but are stated by the host without a source.
